review.mathCheck: The 50 odd terms sum to 2500. Changing the m largest terms gives the minimum possible value, \(2(50-m)^2-2500\). This is 92 for 14 changes and −50 for 15 changes. Thus 15, choice B, is necessary and sufficient; the initial 1 remains positive.
